draft.headline: Fox News Joins Major Outlets in White House Press Pool Boycott, Triggering Trump Cable Blackout
draft.body: Fox News joined all other major outlets in boycotting the White House press pool. US networks, including Fox News, halted coverage of the White House press pool. The suspension left President Trump with a cable blackout from the White House. The coordinated boycott removed the primary conduit for televised White House briefings, creating a temporary gap in cable news coverage of the administration. Consequently, viewers of major cable networks were unable to see live or recorded briefings from the Trump White House until the pool was reinstated.
